title: Uncertain incremental value of a blood eosinophil–neutrophil interaction for retrospective asthma attacks across two NHANES samples
abstract: Among 435 NHANES 2009–2010 adults with current asthma, adding a log-eosinophil × log-neutrophil interaction to flexible marginal-count and demographic models changed weighted Brier error from 0.27954357 to 0.27821988. The baseline-minus-augmented gain was 0.00132369 (source-and-target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00246884, 0.00343310]); added utility was not established, and both models underperformed a source-derived constant risk.
